values.note: The city's page says 'limit 14 days'; its RoverPass rules say 14 nights in the same campsite, after which you may move to another site. A camping permit, displayed on the site post, is required for every night. Check-out noon.

booking.source: https://www.rifleco.org/91/Rifle-Mountain-Park ('Online Camping Reservations Now Available at Rifle Mountain Park', linking the RoverPass booking page; 'Camp Sites are on a first come, first served basis.'; 'Camping in designated areas only; limit 14 days') + https://www.roverpass.com/c/rifle-mountain-park-rifle-co/ (city's rules: '14-Night Stay Limit: Campers may stay in the same campsite for a maximum of 14 nights. After 14 nights, you may remain in the park, but you must move to a different campsite.'; 'Check-out time: 12:00 PM (noon).'), read 2026-10-28

note: City of Rifle park, not the neighbouring Rifle Falls State Park, in a limestone canyon along East Rifle Creek, reached by a gravel road past the fish hatchery at the end of Highway 325, with over 250 bolted climbing routes. The 14 Huffman Gulch sites stay first come, first served; sites marked Van take no trailers. A 23-ft rig fits the larger drive-in sites. --Claude
summary: City page + the city's own claimed RoverPass listing: confirmed dry camping (no electric/water/sewer, no potable water), reservable on RoverPass via the city's link plus first-come sites, $30 camping fee incl. day pass ($20 with an annual pass; fees left), Van sites take no trailers, gravel road past the hatchery, phone. Added season Apr 1-Oct 1, the booking deep link, 14-night limit. Note: pass-requirement line dropped (in fees.note); rest kept.
flags: Second website (RoverPass) is the city's own claimed listing, not an unclaimed directory page: the city's page links its booking URL, and the listing carries the city's rules and 'Last Updated: 10/06/2026'. Keep it.

RoverPass shows 'Starting Daily $20.00'; that is the camping fee alone, since a $10 daily pass must be bought separately ('Annual Passes cover day-use only and does not include camping fees'). Consistent with the city's $30 'Camping fee (includes day pass purchase)'. Stored fees left as they are.
Stay limit: city page 'limit 14 days', RoverPass rules '14 nights in the same campsite ... you may remain in the park, but you must move'. Recorded 14 with both in booking.note.

No site count or length published by the city or its listing; the 'A 23-ft rig fits the larger drive-in sites' line and the '14 Huffman Gulch sites' have no official source but nothing contradicts them (kept). No RV/road-length wording beyond 'The road will change to gravel after the fish hatchery'.

Waterfront creekside kept: on the Esri topo map East Rifle Creek runs ~15-20 m west of the pin, and the campsite clearing just north of the pin lies between the road and the creek's tree line (small canyon creek, well under 30 m).
Pin 39.72580,-107.68876 sits at a road junction beside a campsite cluster near the park entrance; the park's sites spread up the canyon. OK.
Phone 970-665-6400 (City of Rifle, on the city page) confirmed; group area/community house reservations (970) 665-6574.
